intro.title: A Timeless Sanctuary
intro.description: Nestled in a serene location, KS Mansion offers an unparalleled experience of luxury and tranquility. Our historic estate combines classic elegance with modern amenities, providing the perfect escape for discerning guests.

historicEstate.title: Historic Estate
historicEstate.description: A beautifully restored mansion with rich history and timeless architecture

privateGardens.title: Private Gardens
privateGardens.description: Expansive landscaped gardens offering peace and natural beauty

gourmetDining.title: Gourmet Dining
gourmetDining.description: Exceptional culinary experiences crafted by our expert chefs

luxuryAmenities.title: Luxury Amenities
luxuryAmenities.description: World-class facilities designed for your comfort and enjoyment

accommodations.pageDescription: Luxurious rooms and suites at KS Mansion
accommodations.title: Accommodations
accommodations.subtitle: Luxurious rooms and suites designed for your ultimate comfort

deluxeSuite.name: Deluxe Suite
deluxeSuite.description: Elegantly appointed suite featuring classic furnishings, modern amenities, and stunning views of our private gardens.

masterSuite.name: Master Suite
masterSuite.description: Our most spacious accommodation featuring a separate living area, premium furnishings, and panoramic estate views.

gardenRoom.name: Garden Room
gardenRoom.description: Charming room with direct access to our beautifully landscaped gardens, perfect for nature lovers.

presidentialSuite.name: Presidential Suite
presidentialSuite.description: The pinnacle of luxury with expansive living spaces, premium furnishings, and unparalleled views from every window.

dining.title: Dining
dining.subtitle: Exceptional culinary experiences crafted with passion

culinaryExcellence.title: Culinary Excellence
culinaryExcellence.description: At KS Mansion, dining is an art form. Our talented chefs create exquisite dishes using the finest seasonal ingredients, combining traditional techniques with innovative approaches to deliver unforgettable gastronomic experiences.

grandDiningRoom.name: The Grand Dining Room
grandDiningRoom.meta: Fine Dining | Dinner Service | Dress Code: Smart Elegant
grandDiningRoom.description: Our signature restaurant offers an elegant dining experience in a stunning historic setting. The menu features contemporary cuisine with locally-sourced ingredients, complemented by an extensive wine list.

gardenTerrace.name: Garden Terrace
gardenTerrace.meta: Al Fresco Dining | All Day | Casual Elegant
gardenTerrace.description: Enjoy breakfast, lunch, or afternoon tea in our beautiful garden setting. The terrace offers lighter fare, fresh salads, and seasonal specialties in a relaxed atmosphere.

wineCellar.name: The Wine Cellar
wineCellar.meta: Private Dining | By Reservation | Intimate Setting
wineCellar.description: An exclusive dining venue surrounded by our impressive wine collection. Perfect for intimate celebrations and special occasions, with a customized menu and wine pairings.

inRoomDining.name: In-Room Dining
inRoomDining.description: Experience the luxury of dining in the privacy of your room. Our 24-hour room service offers the full dining menu, along with special breakfast options and late-night selections.

chefsTable.title: Chef's Table
chefsTable.description: An exclusive evening at the chef's table with a specially designed tasting menu and kitchen tour.

cookingClasses.title: Cooking Classes
cookingClasses.description: Learn culinary secrets from our master chefs in hands-on cooking workshops.

winePairing.title: Wine Pairing Dinners
winePairing.description: Multi-course dinners expertly paired with selections from our celebrated wine cellar.

privatePicnics.title: Private Picnics
privatePicnics.description: Gourmet picnic baskets for romantic afternoons in our estate grounds.

cta.title: Reserve Your Table
cta.description: Book your dining experience or inquire about our special culinary events.

intro.title: Discover Exceptional Experiences
intro.description: At KS Mansion, we offer a carefully curated selection of experiences designed to create lasting memories. From wellness retreats to cultural immersions, each activity is crafted with attention to detail.

spaWellness.title: Spa & Wellness
spaWellness.description: Rejuvenate your body and mind with our comprehensive wellness programs. Our spa features traditional and modern treatments, meditation gardens, and expert therapists.

estateTours.title: Guided Estate Tours
estateTours.description: Explore the rich history and architecture of KS Mansion with our expert guides. Walk through centuries of heritage and discover hidden gems throughout the estate.

wineTasting.title: Wine & Spirit Tasting
wineTasting.description: Indulge in exclusive tastings from our carefully curated collection. Our sommelier guides you through rare vintages and premium spirits.

outdoorAdventures.title: Outdoor Adventures
outdoorAdventures.description: Experience nature at its finest with our outdoor activities. From leisurely walks to active pursuits, there's something for every guest.

culturalImmersion.title: Cultural Immersion
culturalImmersion.description: Engage with local culture through authentic experiences. Our programs connect you with artisans, musicians, and cultural experts.

privateEvents.title: Private Events
privateEvents.description: Host unforgettable celebrations in our elegant spaces. From intimate gatherings to grand celebrations, we create bespoke events.

cta.title: Ready to Create Your Perfect Experience?
cta.description: Contact our concierge team to customize your stay with these exclusive experiences.

contact.subtitle: We're here to assist you with any inquiries

byCar.title: By Car
byCar.description: From downtown, take Main Street north for 5 miles. Turn right on Luxury Boulevard and continue for 2 miles. The mansion entrance is on the left.

byAir.title: By Air
byAir.description: International Airport is 30 minutes away. We offer private transfer services. Please contact our concierge to arrange pickup.

byTrain.title: By Train
byTrain.description: Central Station is 15 minutes from the mansion. Taxi and ride-sharing services are readily available at the station.
